title: IpfsError::WriteFailed misused for read failures in transit backend
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/object_store_backend.rs, get_raw maps all non-NotFound errors to IpfsError::WriteFailed (line 70). This is a mislabeled error: a transient read failure (network timeout, permissions on GET) surfaces as 'IPFS write failed' in logs and at the call site. The transit IpfsError enum has only WriteFailed; there is no ReadFailed variant. This is a pre-existing issue in the S3 backend that was carried forward unchanged into the shared ObjectStoreBackend. It makes debugging read-side failures harder because the error message says 'write failed' for what is actually a read error.
